module: Generic tutorial engine: it chains "steps" that are each a separate Lua extension (prefix + step identifier). It loads/unloads the current step's extension, stores progress (completed steps, current step) and relays onUpdate/onPreRender to the active step, to damage tracking, to the markers and to the zone bounds system. A modder uses it by calling configure() then start().
usage:
gameplay_tutorial_runtime.configure({stepOrder = {"1", "2"}, stepExtensionPrefix = "career_modules_tutorial_step"})
gameplay_tutorial_runtime.start()
-- from a completed step:
gameplay_tutorial_runtime.advanceToNextStep()
notes: A step's extension is loaded under the name stepExtensionPrefix .. stepId; it can expose setup(), cleanup(), onUpdate() and onPreRender().
stop() unloads the step without marking the tutorial as completed and cleans up neither markers, nor bounds, nor setup; endTutorial() does this full cleanup and sets isCompleted to true.
A step identifier is converted to a string by activateStep (tostring); completeStep, on the other hand, uses the identifier as is as the key in completedSteps.
onUpdate updates damage tracking (damageTracker) even when the tutorial is not active.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: gameplay_tutorial_setup, _markers, _damageTracker and _bounds.

sharedTutorialData.desc: Shared empty table that steps can use to exchange data.

configure.desc: Sets the configuration: step order, step extension prefix, initial prefabs, loading of sites and blocked actions at start, onStarted/onEnded callbacks. Also wires the getters of the bounds and markers modules (tutorial vehicle).

opts.desc: Optional fields: stepOrder (list of ids), stepExtensionPrefix, initialPrefabs, loadSitesOnStart, setupBlockedActionsOnStart, onStarted, onEnded.

setProgressData.desc: Replaces the progress (current step, completed steps, completed flag), typically after loading a save.

data.desc: Table with currentStepId, completedSteps (table id -> true) and isCompleted.

getProgressData.desc: Returns the internal progress table (not a copy).

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the tutorial is in progress.

returns.desc: nil if no step is active.

getStepOrder.desc: Returns the configured ordered list of step identifiers.

getStepIdByIndex.desc: Step identifier at a given position in the configured order.

start.desc: Starts the tutorial: activates the initial prefabs, loads the sites, installs the blocked actions, then activates the stored step (or the first one if invalid). Calls onStarted on success.

returns.desc: false if already active, if stepOrder is empty or if the step could not be activated.

activateStep.desc: Cleans up and unloads the previous step, loads the new step's extension, updates progress and calls its setup({}).

returns.desc: false if inactive, invalid id or extension not found.

completeStep.desc: Marks a step as completed in completedSteps.

returns.desc: false if the tutorial is not active.

advanceToNextStep.desc: Completes the current step then activates the next one; if there are none left, calls endTutorial().

returns.desc: false if inactive or if the current step is not in stepOrder.

endTutorial.desc: Normal end: cleanup of the step, markers, damage tracking, bounds and setup; sets isCompleted to true, clears the UI task list (ClearTasklist) and calls onEnded.

returns.desc: false if the tutorial was not active.

stop.desc: Unloads the active step without marking the tutorial as completed and without cleaning up the other modules.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame by the extension engine: passes the tutorial vehicle id to the damageTracker, relays to the active step, updates damage, markers and bounds.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering: relays to the active step (dtReal, dtSim only) and to the bounds module.
